wins: Maintained consistent reward accumulation (37.5) despite no successful run completions, indicating stable partial progress that can be built upon.
Leveraged mentor guidance effectively across 15 mentor calls to adjust tactics mid-run, preventing larger regressions.
fails: Failed to achieve any successful episode completion (0% success rate), pointing to critical unresolved steps in later stages.
Repeated inability to capitalize on reconnaissance findings, leaving exploitable services unexploited during final phases.
key_outcomes.summary: Despite steady reward gains and extensive mentor guidance, the run consistently stalled before success; focus next on closing the exploitation and persistence gaps highlighted by repeated failure patterns.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance identifies open services but the run never transitions into exploitation, leaving targets untouched.
Post-exploitation cleanup or persistence was never established, causing sessions to drop and preventing completion.
